assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 updates its metrics so that they reflect function and controller scope (PR #6640), but the release note does not identify which metric names or labels changed or what this means for consumers of those metrics.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names only 'metrics' generically; it does not identify which metric names, labels, or component the change concerns, so no subject identity can be pinned.; applicability: The evidence does not identify which metrics or labels changed, nor what environment state (e.g. dashboards, alerts, or scrape configs referencing specific metric names) would be exposed, so no exposure predicate can be written.; consequence: The evidence does not state what happens to environments that consume these metrics (e.g. whether metric names or labels they rely on changed, were removed, or were added).
